notes.title: Steam Major Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support! We highly value your feedback, and this major update brings a series of fixes and improvements to enhance your overall experience:[/p][p]1. Fixed the black screen issue after pressing Start Game.[/p][p]2. Fixed the button failure when no dialogue options were available.[/p][p]3. Fixed the black screen at the beginning of the hidden side story.[/p][p]4. Fixed the infinite loop at the end of Chapter 10.[/p][p]5. Fixed the issue where the next line would not auto-progress after selecting an option.[/p][p]6. All English localization text has been manually proofread, making the reading experience smoother and more natural.[/p][p]7. The English version now features newly recorded voice acting by professional actors, making performances more emotional and authentic.[/p][p]We will continue to listen to our community and keep improving the game experience. Thank you for your patience and passionate support, enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p]Tarnaki Games[/p]

notes.title: Available on August 18th!
notes.notes: [p]Dear Players and Friends who have supported us:[/p][p]We are thrilled to announce a major piece of news – our passionately developed game has now been officially completed![/p][p]From the initial concept to countless days and nights of hard work, and now to its perfect presentation, this journey has been full of challenges and joy. We have poured immense effort into perfecting every detail of the game, striving to bring you an unprecedented immersive experience.[/p][p]Now, it's time to officially present this work, which embodies all the passion and creativity of our team, to you![/p][p]We are very honored to announce that this game will be officially launched on the Steam platform on August 18, 2025![/p][p]At that time, all eagerly awaiting players will be able to find and download our game on the Steam store page. Whether you are an adventurer who loves to explore vast worldviews, a wise person who enjoys strategy and challenges, or a narrative enthusiast who enjoys immersive storylines, we believe this game will bring you surprises and emotions.[/p][p]Please mark your calendars and get ready for this upcoming digital feast! We can't wait to see you explore, challenge, and create your own stories in the game.[/p][p]Thank you again for your continued attention and support! See you on Steam on August 18th![/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]Tarnaki Games[/p]

notes.title: Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
Dear Players,  
The demo for “Dracula: End of Days” is live! Experience Chapter 1: Outbreak as researcher Henry escaping a contaminated lab, with gameplay featuring:  
- 30-min story-driven survival  
- Branching choices system  
- Hidden clues about future mutations
